summary: Planned 7 sequential phases (6.5h) to recover source PDFs from the live Zotero library into sources/<doc_id>/. Success criterion is the research-verified ~7 recoverable of 52, with the rest honestly left as no_source_pdf. Plan is snapshot-backed, dry-run-first, and idempotent because it mutates the user-owned corpus at ~/Projects/Literature/. Explicitly does NOT recreate the deliberately dissolved pdfs/ directory.

artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan: snapshot/env-probe, build read-only zotero-resolve-pdf.sh, dry-run sweep of all 52 targets, secondary verification gate for non-key-anchored matches, idempotent apply, fidelity re-audit, documentation and summary.

decisions_made: Do NOT recreate ~/Projects/Literature/pdfs/; it was deliberately dissolved on 2026-06-16 (commit 404bb36). Recovered PDFs go into sources/<doc_id>/.
Success is ~7 recovered of 52, not 52. The 30-entry arXiv hardware-verification cluster has zero presence in this Zotero library; marking it no_source_pdf is the correct outcome.
Target list is index.json entries with provenance_fidelity == 'no_source_pdf' (52), consumed directly; the description's '49 chunk-bearing + 3 empty' split is stale (0 dirs are empty).
Resolution is live Zotero HTTP API first; sqlite is locked while Zotero runs. zotero_key is a fast path for only 2 of 52 entries.
Storage root is derived from zotero-resolve-sqlite-path.sh's dataDir, never hardcoded to ~/Zotero/storage/ (the fetch_path3() bug).
Non-key-anchored title matches require a secondary year/DOI/venue check before apply; fine_2014 is routed to explicit confirmation, never auto-approved.
provenance_fidelity is never hand-stamped; it is recomputed by literature-fidelity-audit.sh after PDFs land.
dead_ends: zotero-library.json (400-entry static snapshot) is not a resolution source: it carries no attachment paths and is demonstrably stale (missing bacon_2018).
sqlite3 -readonly against zotero.sqlite fails with 'database is locked' while Zotero is running; do not retry it in that state.
